title: Refine one random prefix instead of retrying an unresolved branch
statement: Each uniform owns one persistent prefix. Normal inversion, inverse-Poisson cumulative tests and factory comparisons refine that same randomness with outward enclosures. The reviewed zero-boundary-mass arguments establish almost-sure termination and exact integer-bin law under the stated fair-bit/arithmetic contract. They do not establish finite expected bit work; absent EXPECTED_BITS.md/certify.py remain an evidence gap.
